T: B1 to need to pay or give something to someone because they have lent money to you, or in exchange for something they have done for you
C2 to have success, happiness, a job, etc. only because of what someone has given you or done for you or because of your own efforts

example: We still owe $1,000 on our car (= we still need to pay $1,000 before we own our car).
我們的車還欠1000美元未付清。
I owe you a drink for helping me move.
你幫我搬家，我該請你喝一杯 。
I think you owe (= should give) me an explanation/apology.
我覺得你得向我解釋一下／道歉。
See also
IOU
I owe my success to my education.
我的成功歸功於我所受的教育。
He owes his life to the staff at the hospital.
他能保住命全虧了這家醫院的醫護人員。
I owe everything (= I am very grateful) to my parents.
我非常感激我的父母。

NONE: › to deserve and need to do something that will be good for you
自己理應做，自己當之無愧

example: Take a few days off work - you owe it to yourself.
休息幾天——你應該歇一歇了。

NONE: › If you say that someone thinks that people owe him or her a living, you mean that that person thinks that he or she deserves to be paid without having to work hard for it

example: He seems to think the world owes him a living.
他似乎覺得世人都有義務照顧他。
No one owes you a living.
沒人有義務養活你。
